license: The upstream smb_description/package.xml declares MIT. Its unmodified declaration is retained as upstream_package.xml. No repository-wide LICENSE file was present in the retrieved archive; the local course-project LICENSE does not replace upstream ownership.
visual_mesh: Original DAE copied byte-for-byte, original base_link mesh origin xyz=[.423,.42,-.25], rpy=[1.57,0,-1.57] and .001 scale retained. One embedded geometry, no external images or textures.

urdf_adaptations.scope: New standalone ROS 2 visualization description using original mesh, box/cylinder geometry and mounting coordinates. This is not a Gazebo simulation port.
urdf_adaptations.joint_data: Current smb_node publishes these four joint names in LF RF LH RH order from integrated measured relative wheel angular velocity, not desired motor velocity.
urdf_adaptations.wheel_visual: Original visual radius .20 m and width .17 m retained. Collision radius .19 m and width .185 m remain distinct, as in the upstream xacro.
urdf_adaptations.inertia: Analytic box and Y-axis cylinder tensors match smb_vehicle.cpp. Corrects original box izz macro x*x+z*z to x*x+y*y, and wheel axial term from Z to Y.
urdf_adaptations.tf_ownership: robot_state_publisher publishes only base_link->inertial_link and the four base_link->wheel links. No map link or smb_lidar link is present; smb_node owns those transforms.
urdf_adaptations.omitted: ROS 1 Gazebo plugins, ros_control transmissions, sensor_head xacro and dependencies are not copied into this visualization URDF.
urdf_adaptations.nominal_geometry: The URDF describes default dimensions and base_link frame. Customized physical geometry requires matching URDF changes.
